card.name: Characters inside URLs and ID strings
card.fires_on: Single digits, plus signs or odd characters in the middle of web addresses, hex-like ID codes and garbled strings. It fires where the text is a link or code rather than prose.

modes.label: Digits in URLs and IDs
modes.description: A single digit inside a long web address or hex-style identifier.

modes.label: Plus sign as space in links
modes.description: A plus sign standing for a space inside a URL path or query.

modes.label: Garbled or odd characters
modes.description: A stray digit or broken character in a range or a corrupted string.

card.plain: It lights up on the random-looking characters inside web links and ID codes.
